gtaiv-dxvk-vr — Config guide (resolution & knobs)
=================================================

All config files sit next to GTAIV.exe (same folder as this ASI).
Edit with Notepad. Save as plain text. Restart the game (or use the hotkey if noted).


1) VR EYE RESOLUTION (sharpness vs FPS)
--------------------------------------
File:  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.vres
Meaning: Max size of each eye canvas (pixels on the long edge). Higher = sharper, more GPU.

This pack ships:

  2048

That is the highest fixed step in the ASI. In-game you can also press F5 to cycle:

  1024 → 1280 → 1536 → 1792 → 2048 → SteamVR recommended

F5 saves the new value back into gtaiv_dxvk_vr.vres.

Examples (edit file, then restart):

  1024   — lightest / smoothest
  1536   — balanced (old comfort default)
  2048   — highest fixed (this pack default)
  2560   — allowed up to 4096 if your PC can take it (manual only)

Note: This is NOT the SteamVR “Supersampling” slider.
SteamVR SS still applies on top when the compositor scales. For more SteamVR pixels:
  SteamVR → Settings → Video → Resolution per eye / Custom resolution.


2) STEREO MODE
--------------
File:  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.stereo

  156  — Default in this pack (Mode 154 FOV + lower eye cam + F5 res)
  154  — Aspect-correct wide FOV only (previous “best feel”)
  120  — Frozen last-good fused stereo (safer fallback)
  0    — Off (flat DXVK on monitor; no stereo submit)


3) FIRST-PERSON STYLE FOV NUMBER
--------------------------------
File:  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.fpfov
Format: Forward Rear Foot   (degrees)

  90 90 90

Change e.g. to 85 85 85 and restart. Extreme values can warp or zoom oddly.


4) CAMERA HEIGHT / OFFSET
-------------------------
File:  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.eyefwd     (cm along look — Mode 156 ignores for pivot)
File:  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.camoff     (right forward up in cm)

  camoff example:  0 0 -3     → nudge camera down 3 cm

Mode 156 uses a fixed ped eye height (~65 cm) + 8 cm forward.


5) OTHER USEFUL FILES
---------------------
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.ipd          — stereo separation (cm); F8 cycles
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.stereoscale  — soft 3D strength; F6 cycles
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.fovadd       — engine FOV add; F7 presets also write this
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.worldscale   — F7 preset index
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.pedhide      — 1 = hide head mesh (recommended)
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.buildid      — which pack build you installed
  gtaiv_dxvk_vr.log          — runtime log (send this when reporting bugs)


6) QUICK “MAKE IT SHARPER” CHECKLIST
------------------------------------
1. Confirm gtaiv_dxvk_vr.vres = 2048 (or press F5 until log says 2048 / recommended).
2. In SteamVR, raise Video resolution / supersampling a bit.
3. In GTA, keep a reasonable game resolution (e.g. 1920×1080 or 2560×1440).
   Do NOT use square 1080×1080 commandline alone — it caused stretch in our tests.
4. If FPS tanks: lower .vres to 1536, then SteamVR SS.


7) QUICK “MAKE IT FASTER” CHECKLIST
-----------------------------------
1. Set gtaiv_dxvk_vr.vres to 1536 or 1280 (or F5 down).
2. Lower SteamVR supersampling.
3. Lower GTA graphics / resolution.
4. Keep stereo=156 or fall back to 120 if something breaks.


8) FIRSTPERSON.ASI
------------------
For Mode 156 this pack expects FirstPerson.asi OFF (rename to FirstPerson.asi.off).
Our ASI owns the camera + FOV path. Running both can fight.
